parameters.name: DIAlarmRuleId
parameters.description: This parameter is deprecated. Use the Id parameter instead.

parameters.name: DIJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the synchronization task.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the alert rule.

parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the alert rule. By default, the alert rule is disabled.

parameters.name: MetricType
parameters.description:
The metric type in the alert rule. Valid values:

- Heartbeat

- FailoverCount

- Delay

- DdlReport

- ResourceUtilization

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the alert rule.

parameters.name: TriggerConditions
parameters.description: The conditions that can trigger the alert rule.

sub_parameters.name: DdlReportTags
sub_parameters.description: This parameter is deprecated and replaced by the DdlTypes parameter.

sub_parameters.name: DdlTypes
sub_parameters.description: The types of DDL operations for which the alert rule takes effect.

sub_parameters.name: Duration
sub_parameters.description: The time interval for alert calculation. Unit: minutes.

sub_parameters.name: Severity
sub_parameters.description:
The severity level. Valid values:

- Warning

- Critical

sub_parameters.name: Threshold
sub_parameters.description:
The alert threshold.

- If the alert rule is for task status, you do not need to specify a threshold.

- If the alert rule is for failovers, you must specify the number of failovers.

- If the alert rule is for latency, you must specify the latency duration, in seconds.
